ArrangeBreadBasket.description: Open the cabinet, pick up the [*bread*] from the cabinet and place it in the basket. Then move the basket to the dining counter.
ArrangeBreadBasket.name: ArrangeBreadBasket

ArrangeTea.description: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on the tray. Then pick the mug from the cabinet and place it on the tray. Then close the cabinet doors.
ArrangeTea.name: ArrangeTea

BreadSelection.description: From the different types of pastries on the counter, select a croissant and place it on the cutting board. Then retrieve a jar of jam from the cabinet and place it alongside the croissant on the cutting board.
BreadSelection.name: BreadSelection

CategorizeCondiments.description: Put the shaker and condiment bottle from the counter next to their counterparts in the cabinet.
CategorizeCondiments.name: CategorizeCondiments

CloseBlenderLid.description: Close the lid blender by securely placing the lid on top.
CloseBlenderLid.name: CloseBlenderLid

CoffeeSetupMug.description: Pick the mug from the counter and place it under the coffee machine dispenser.
CoffeeSetupMug.name: CoffeeSetupMug

CuttingToolSelection.description: Place the appropriate cutting tool for cutting the [*fruit/vegetable*] skin on the cutting board.
CuttingToolSelection.name: CuttingToolSelection

DeliverStraw.description: Take a straw from the drawer in front and place it inside the glass cup on the dining counter.
DeliverStraw.name: DeliverStraw

GarnishPancake.description: Take the strawberry from the fridge and place it on top of the pancake, located on the dining counter.
GarnishPancake.name: GarnishPancake

GatherTableware.description: Gather all objects into one cabinet and sort the glasses and bowls to opposite sides.
GatherTableware.name: GatherTableware

GetToastedBread.description: Start the toaster. Once the lever pops up, take the bread to the plate on the dining counter.
GetToastedBread.name: GetToastedBread

HeatKebabSandwich.description: Pick up the kebab skewer and baguette bread, and place them inside the toaster oven. Close the toaster oven door and start by setting the timer.
HeatKebabSandwich.name: HeatKebabSandwich

KettleBoiling.description: Pick the kettle from the counter and place it on a stove burner. Then turn the burner on.
KettleBoiling.name: KettleBoiling

LoadDishwasher.description: Pick up the [*dishes*] from the counter, place them in the dishwasher, and close the dishwasher door.
LoadDishwasher.name: LoadDishwasher

MakeIceLemonade.description: Grab a lemon wedge from the fridge and one ice cube from the ice bowl, and put them in the glass of lemonade.
MakeIceLemonade.name: MakeIceLemonade

PackIdenticalLunches.description: Place one [*vegetable*] and one [*meat*] in each tupperware on the nearby counter, to pack two identical lunches.
PackIdenticalLunches.name: PackIdenticalLunches

PanTransfer.description: Pick up the pan and dump the vegetables in it onto the plate. Then return the pan to the stove.
PanTransfer.name: PanTransfer

PickPlaceCounterToCabinet.description: Pick the item from the counter and place it in the cabinet.
PickPlaceCounterToCabinet.name: PickPlaceCounterToCabinet

PickPlaceCounterToStove.description: Pick the item from the plate and place it in the pan.
PickPlaceCounterToStove.name: PickPlaceCounterToStove

PickPlaceDrawerToCounter.description: Pick the item from the drawer and place it on the counter.
PickPlaceDrawerToCounter.name: PickPlaceDrawerToCounter

PickPlaceSinkToCounter.description: Pick the item from the sink and place it on the container located on the counter.
PickPlaceSinkToCounter.name: PickPlaceSinkToCounter

PickPlaceToasterToCounter.description: Place the toasted item on a plate.
PickPlaceToasterToCounter.name: PickPlaceToasterToCounter

PortionHotDogs.description: Place one bun and one sausage from the bowl on each plate.
PortionHotDogs.name: PortionHotDogs

PreSoakPan.description: Pick the pan and sponge and place them into the sink. Then turn on the water.
PreSoakPan.name: PreSoakPan

PrepareCoffee.description: Pick the mug from the cabinet, place it under the coffee machine dispenser, and press the start button.
PrepareCoffee.name: PrepareCoffee

RecycleBottlesByType.description: Move the plastic bottles in the middle to the plastics group, and the glass bottles in the middle to the glass group.
RecycleBottlesByType.name: RecycleBottlesByType

RinseSinkBasin.description: Turn on the sink and manuever the spout to wash all locations of the sink basin.
RinseSinkBasin.name: RinseSinkBasin

ScrubCuttingBoard.description: Pick up the sponge from the counter and clean the cutting board by briefly scrubbing or pressing down on the cutting board. Once finished, release the sponge.
ScrubCuttingBoard.name: ScrubCuttingBoard

SearingMeat.description: Grab the pan from the cabinet and place it on the [*burner location*] burner on the stove. Then place the [*meat*] on the stove and turn the burner on.
SearingMeat.name: SearingMeat

SeparateFreezerRack.description: Take the meat container that has the [*meat*] and place it on the second highest rack of the freezer. Then take the vegetable container that has the [*vegetables*] and place it on the highest rack of the freezer.
SeparateFreezerRack.name: SeparateFreezerRack

SetUpCuttingStation.description: Pick up the knife from the drawer and place it on the cutting board. Then place the meat from the plate to the cutting board.
SetUpCuttingStation.name: SetUpCuttingStation

SlideDishwasherRack.description: Fully slide the top dishwasher rack {in/out}.
SlideDishwasherRack.name: SlideDishwasherRack

StackBowlsCabinet.description: Pick up the bowls on the counter and stack them on top of one another in the open cabinet. Place the smaller bowl on top of the larger bowl.
StackBowlsCabinet.name: StackBowlsCabinet

SteamInMicrowave.description: Pick the [*vegetable*] from the sink and place it in the bowl. Then pick the bowl and place it in the microwave. Then close the microwave door and press the start button.
SteamInMicrowave.name: SteamInMicrowave

StirVegetables.description: Put the [*vegetables*] in the pot. Retrieve the spatula and lightly stir the vegetables in the pot.
StirVegetables.name: StirVegetables

StoreLeftoversInBowl.description: Pick the chicken drumstick and [*vegetable*] from their plates and place them in the bowl. Then put the bowl in the fridge.
StoreLeftoversInBowl.name: StoreLeftoversInBowl

TurnOffStove.description: Turn off the [burner location] burner of the stove.
TurnOffStove.name: TurnOffStove

TurnOnElectricKettle.description: Press down the lever to turn on the electric kettle.
TurnOnElectricKettle.name: TurnOnElectricKettle

TurnOnMicrowave.description: Press the start button on the microwave.
TurnOnMicrowave.name: TurnOnMicrowave

WaffleReheat.description: Open the microwave, place the bowl with waffle inside the microwave, then close the microwave door and turn it on.
WaffleReheat.name: WaffleReheat

WashFruitColander.description: Put the colander in the sink, put the [*fruit*] in the colander, and turn on the sink faucet and pour water over the colander.
WashFruitColander.name: WashFruitColander

WashLettuce.description: Wash the lettuce in the sink by running water over it.
WashLettuce.name: WashLettuce

WeighIngredients.description: Pick the [*packaged food*] and place it on the digital scale for weighing, and close the cabinet.
WeighIngredients.name: WeighIngredients
